entries.reason: rank 18 of coordination/corpus/crash-demand-top.tsv, LOAD-FAIL, class_confirmed against both telegram and yattee's own trees; five of telegram's own submodules confirm real picture-in-picture in calls, not an availability check. apple.objc.inventory() against the armv7 shared cache of 6.1.3 found no AVPictureInPictureController/AVPictureInPictureControllerDelegate under any name; AVPlayerLayer, the real class -initWithPlayerLayer: takes, is already real and exported. Ladder-walked to 9.0, matching the header. grep of this tree's own .m files found no orphaned implementation. AVKit.framework does not exist at all on this release, and no cross-app window-compositing surface exists for a third-party dylib to draw into - the wall this port cannot cross, the same one CoreSpotlight's own search bundle hit and CallKitBackports' RevenantCallScreen answers by shipping only the application side of a two-process design
entries.effect: a facade that floats the caller's real AVPlayerLayer into a draggable UIWindow above the host app's own content while the app stays in the foreground - the same CALayer, still attached to the same AVPlayer, reparented back exactly where it came from on -stopPictureInPicture. Does not survive the host app losing focus - no SpringBoard-side companion exists in this tree for it, the one dimension this port cannot reach without one
unconditionally YES - unlike the system feature this substitutes for, an in-app floating window needs no hardware entitlement or background-video capability
